title: Email-marketing campaign dashboard — Postwick
notes: v1 is a BEM-styled server-rendered page. v2 is an Angular Material rewrite (mat-card/mat-toolbar/mat-tab-nav-bar markup, _ngcontent attributes, ligature mat-icons): nav links get three wrapper divs, a new order and a new 'Sign-up forms' item (a hidden overflow menu repeats 'Automations'); stat values become divs in a new order with relabelled captions; campaign cards are regrouped (two sending campaigns first, so 'Pause sending' appears twice) and their buttons are MDC buttons with label spans ('Pause' -> 'Pause sending', 'Resume' -> 'Resume sending'). The A/B-test table becomes variant cards inside an <ab-test-panel> Lit element (declarative shadow root) placed above the campaigns, with a renamed winner-metric select.
